title: Voice-clone scams and a family code word
intro: AI can copy a real person's voice from a few seconds of recording. Scammers use this to sound like someone in your family.
The signs: an urgent call or voice message, a request for money, a code or details, and being asked not to tell anyone.
The fix: a family code word that only your family knows. If the voice doesn't know it, hang up and call your parent on their usual number.

game.prompt: Sort each call or message: normal or suspicious?
game.practiceNotice: These are practice situations we made up for this game. They are not real.

items.text: A call in your cousin's voice, crying and asking you to quickly send the code that came to Mom's phone
items.explain: Crying, rushing and asking for a code are scam signs. Hang up and tell a parent.

items.text: Grandma calls, says the family code word and asks how you are
items.explain: She knows the code word and doesn't ask for anything strange. A normal call.

items.text: A video of a famous singer promising money to anyone who sends their parents' credit card details
items.explain: Famous voices and faces are easy to fake. Real celebrities don't ask for card details.

items.text: Dad texts from his usual number: "I'll be ten minutes late"
items.explain: A normal message from his usual number, with no strange requests.

items.text: A voice message that sounds like your big brother: "I'm in trouble, send money and don't tell Mom"
items.explain: "Don't tell" together with a request for money is a warning sign. Check with a parent.

items.text: Your teacher posts a reminder in the class group to bring a hat tomorrow
items.explain: A normal reminder in a group you know, with no pressure and no requests for details.

quiz.question: What is a family code word?
options: A secret word only your family knows, to check who's really talking
quiz.explain: The code word helps you find out if the voice really belongs to who it claims to be.

quiz.question: A voice that sounds like your parent urgently asks for money and doesn't know the code word. What do you do?
options: Hang up and call your parent on their usual number
Keep talking to find out more
quiz.explain: Call the number you know yourself. That's how you quickly find out if it's really your parent.

quiz.question: Can AI copy the voice of someone you know?
options: Yes, sometimes from a few seconds of recording
quiz.explain: So a familiar voice alone isn't proof. The code word is the check.

summary: AI can copy voices. When an urgent call asks for money, a code or a secret, check your family code word, and if something's off, hang up and call your parent on their usual number.
